scope: Michal and Renata Hornstein Pavilion at 1379 Sherbrooke Street West. The standing exterior includes entire native historic pavilion and Norton return.

originalReview.notes: Use the verified front original for the recessed four-column Ionic portico, three dark oak arched entrances, central entablature, paired bas-reliefs and narrow tall square lights. The original marble front faces southeast across Sherbrooke Street. Keep pale stone and quiet green coping. Model the north-side additions separately per native outlines.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla images were screened first. Its exact Hornstein original refers to the 1912 pavilion, and the Inuit gallery photo shows interior exhibits. The Bourgie local rendition did not match the photographer’s original file. No museum or architects’ images were imported as appearance sources.
